description: Source code for handling Discord component message sending, editing, and related utilities within a larger application. Includes functions for constructing payloads, managing attachments, and interfacing with Discord API.

methods.name: extractComponentAttachmentNames
methods.description: Extracts attachment names from a DiscordComponentMessageSpec.

methods.name: hasComponentAttachmentBlock
methods.description: Checks if the spec contains a file block.

methods.name: withImplicitComponentAttachmentBlock
methods.description: Adds a file block with attachment name if missing.

methods.name: hasClassicOnlyBlocks
methods.description: Checks if spec contains only text or file blocks.

methods.name: hasUnsupportedClassicFeatures
methods.description: Detects unsupported features like modal or container in spec.

methods.name: hasAtMostOneNonSpoilerFile
methods.description: Ensures spec has at most one non-spoiler file block.

methods.name: getClassicDiscordMessageDecision
methods.description: Determines if spec can be sent as a classic message or needs components.

methods.name: collapseClassicComponentText
methods.description: Concatenates text parts of spec into a single string.

methods.name: registerBuiltDiscordComponentMessage
methods.description: Registers a built Discord component message with registry.

methods.name: buildDiscordComponentPayload
methods.description: Constructs payload for Discord component message, handling media and attachments.

methods.name: sendDiscordComponentMessage
methods.description: Sends a Discord component message, downgrading to plain text if needed.

methods.name: editDiscordComponentMessage
methods.description: Edits an existing Discord component message.
